## EconomyCoreRootClass

EconomyCoreRootClass registers one game class hierarchy with Central Economy and
identifies whether its instances are loot, characters, or cars.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### EconomyCoreRootClass.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`classes`](#economycorefileeconomycoreclasses).[`rootclass`](#economycoreclassesrootclass).`[]`.`name`

Name is the root class name from the game's configuration inheritance.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `DefaultWeapon` |

### EconomyCoreRootClass.act

Key: `act`

Path: [`classes`](#economycorefileeconomycoreclasses).[`rootclass`](#economycoreclassesrootclass).`[]`.`act`

Act tells CE how to initialize this class: `character` for players, infected,
and animals; `car` for vehicles; or omitted/`none` for ordinary economy items.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `none` |
| Enum | `none`, `character`, `car` |
| Examples | `character` |

### EconomyCoreRootClass.reportMemoryLOD

Key: `reportMemoryLOD`

Path: [`classes`](#economycorefileeconomycoreclasses).[`rootclass`](#economycoreclassesrootclass).`[]`.`reportMemoryLOD`

ReportMemoryLOD controls warnings for missing Memory LODs on instances of this
class (`yes` or `no`). The documented default is `yes`.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Default | `yes` |
| Enum | `yes`, `no` |
| Examples | `no` |
